measures.title: Bonds to Replace Deteriorating Wenatchee High School and Improve School Air Quality Districtwide
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes $275,000,000 of general obligation bonds, maturing within 20 years and repaid by excess property taxes, to build a new Wenatchee High School on the existing campus (replacing classrooms and portables, expanding career/technical education space) and replace aging HVAC at seven other schools; it would also qualify the district for an estimated $83,000,000 in state matching funds.
measures.cost_line: $275,000,000 in bonds over up to 20 years; the district estimates $1.46 per $1,000 of assessed value a year.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Public Safety and Government Services Levy Lid Lift
measures.what_it_does: Lifts Cashmere's regular property tax levy to keep essential city services, including public safety, operating, and lets the levy rise up to 9% a year from 2028 to 2032; the 2032 levy becomes the base for future levy limits.
measures.cost_line: $1.5737 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection, then up to 9% more a year through 2032.
